scope: Actual bundled read-only analysis model; physical bytes, container declarations, explicit mappings and instruction candidates. No browser layout or universal emulator acceptance claim.

results.name: Unknown engine and mapper open for inspection without changing project, undo or emulator
Raw non-NES binary and empty file retain exact physical identity without invented platform
Truncated, extended and invalid NES headers fall back to raw bytes rather than reject analysis
NROM 16KiB mirror mapping and vectors use real physical offsets
Trainer, distinct NROM32 banks and trailing bytes retain exact spans and hash
NES2 mapper high bits, submapper and linear ROM size are decoded without runtime claims
NES2 exponent-multiplier sizes and unsafe declarations are handled without allocations from headers
NES2 linear size upper nibble is measured in PRG and CHR units
Input bytes are copied synchronously before asynchronous digest resolves
Caller ArrayBuffer views and returned objects cannot mutate retained bytes or evidence
Shared memory, unsupported input and unavailable hash are rejected clearly
Input and all public output bounds reject negatives, overflow, fractional values and oversized requests
Explicit CPU mappings preserve overlapping banks and reject crossing physical or CPU limits
Every documented addressing form uses correct little-endian operands and instruction lengths
Relative branches use signed offsets and wrap targets only with an explicit CPU origin
Disassembly is independent from static NROM mapping and absolute jumps expose encoded targets only
Unknown opcodes and truncated operands retain exact bytes with uncertainty instead of fabricated instructions
NMOS and 2A03 document exactly 151 encodings and reject accidental CMOS decoding
Chunked search retains every match crossing scan boundaries without duplicate offsets
Result-limited search resumes overlapping repeated matches without skipping
Search validates pattern and scan progress, and reads at most its explicit bound
Physical CHR bitplanes and source evidence decode independently of an unsupported mapper
CHR RAM and raw layouts never invent graphics from unrelated bytes
